question: Should sessions.list establish a stable cross-client presentation contract, and if so how should plugin-owned session families extend its family and background classification?
rationale: The proposal adds a durable Gateway API consumed by native clients and must balance stable enums, plugin ownership, privacy, transcript-I/O cost, and generated-client compatibility; source inspection cannot choose that permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a generic projection
options.body: Add the presentation object using authoritative generic fields and a narrow plugin projection hook for owner-specific family metadata.

options.title: Keep only existing fields
options.body: Continue exposing independent row fields and require each client to compose titles and background classification locally.

options.title: Stage titles before taxonomy
options.body: First standardize a cheap guaranteed title/subtitle contract, then design family and background metadata in a separate protocol proposal.

recommendation.title: Approve a generic projection
recommendation.body: Add the presentation object using authoritative generic fields and a narrow plugin projection hook for owner-specific family metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the concrete maintainer-labeled API proposal and is the clearest available owner for deciding its intended contract.
